title: Back on the boat with Creath; Fate Marable wants him
summary: Creath sends for him the next summer and refuses to release him to Marable, and shapes his band toward a blend of New Orleans and St. Louis styles.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Well, he used an mute, you see. Where, where Freddy used an open hand. Yeah. You see. Well, now, after I come back to Chicago, then the next summer, Charlie sent for me to come back to go to work on the boat. And then, meanwhile, boy, his name, I don't take my term, I'll forget it. Fate had heard about me. And Fate wanted me to take this trumpet player.

There had been a Joe Howard from New Orleans on that boat, but he was an older man than he, I don't think he ever went to Milwaukee. No. It wasn't Joe Howard. Sidney Desveen was another one there. Yeah, he worked on that. He worked with you, I think.
I have a picture of him and you, both together on the boat. Yeah. Well, this is why I'll take my fate away.
No, I can't think either. The name will come, I guess.

Well, Charlie wouldn't release me to go to Fate. So, I had to stay up still with Charlie on the boat. You see, during that time, but then Charlie was beginning to make his band, bring his band more of between a New Orleans style and a St. Louis style. So, you had the New Orleans St. Louis style and the St. Paul, and you had the straight Dixieland New Orleans style with a Fate Man or Boydichess. And that's the way St. Louis wanted it.
